note: Second-session test, session two. Every question of fold 0 of tests/dev/folds.json asked again as written (group repeated, taken from tests/dev/questions.json and tests/dev/closure.json at run time by id), reworded with the same meaning in other words (group reworded), and asked about the same places from another angle (group angle). Answers use the same anchors as the source question; each answer is found at run time by its anchor line. Written for the second-session test only; never a release measure.
